---
title: "Research Groups"
---

ÇAHSPAR’s research groups connect disciplines and regional expertise around shared questions in working life and social policy. They provide a basis for comparative studies, international project development, scholarly exchange and collaboration across career stages.

- [Social Policy, Poverty and Welfare](sosyal-politika-yoksulluk-ve-refah.qmd)
- [Working Life and Employment](calisma-hayati-ve-istihdam.qmd)
- [Women’s Studies and Gender](kadin-calismalari-ve-toplumsal-cinsiyet.qmd)
- [Social Entrepreneurship and Sustainability Studies](sosyal-girisimcilik-ve-surdurulebilirlik.qmd)
- [Digital Transformation, Artificial Intelligence and the Society of the Future](dijital-donusum-yapay-zeka-ve-gelecegin-toplumu.qmd)
- [Migration, Integration and Social Cohesion](goc-uyum-ve-sosyal-butunlesme.qmd)
- [Youth and Education Studies](genclik-ve-egitim-calismalari.qmd)

The groups share an international research horizon and use the [association’s geographical framework](about.qmd#a-global-research-horizon) as a reference. Each study will define its country coverage, methods and sources of evidence.
